اقتطفوا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَطَفُوا (iqtaṭafū) /iq.ta.tˤa.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# اُقْتُطِفُوا (uqtuṭifū) /uq.tu.tˤi.fuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
# اِقْتَطِفُوا (iqtaṭifū) /iq.ta.tˤi.fuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْتَطَفَ (iqtaṭafa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
